definitions.short: properly, to keep in ; hence, to measure ; figuratively, to maintain (in various senses)
definitions.usage: (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold(-ing in), nourish(-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).
definitions.full: H3557. kul [ כּוּל ] verb comprehend, contain (Late Hebrew, Aramaic id., measure, measure out , of dry or liquid measure; Syriac Aph`el id. ; Arabic measure grain) — Qal Perfect only Isa 40:12 הָאָרֶץ עֲפַר בְּשָׁלִשׁ מִיכָּ֗֗֗ל who hath comprehended the dust of the earth in a shalish-measure ? Pilpel Perfect כִּלְכֵּל 2Sam 19:33 ; suffix כִּלְכְּלָם 1Kin 18:4 ; 2 masculine singular suffix כִּלְכַּלְתָּם Neh 9:21 , etc.; Imperfect יְכַלְכֵּל Zech 11:16 +, etc.; Infinitive construct כַּלְכֵּל Jer 20:9 +, etc.; Participle מְכַלְכֵּל Mal 3:2 ; — sustain, maintain, contain: 1 sustain, support, nourish , followed by accusative of person Gen 45:11 ; 50:21 (both E), 2Sam 19:33 ; 19:34 ; 20:3 ; 1Kin 4:7 a (v:b absolute), 5:7 ; 17:4 , 9 ; Neh 9:21 ; Ruth 4:15 ; Psa 55:23 ; Zech 11:16 (of sheep); followed by accusative of person + of thing (food) Gen 47:12 (J), 1Kin 18:4 , 13 . 2 contain , followed by accusative of person 1Kin 8:27 ; 2Chr 2:5 ; 6:18 (heavens cannot contain ׳י ); hold in, restrain Yahweh's word within one, Jer 20:9 . 3 support, endure , sickness ׳יְכַל מַחֲלֵ֑הוּ אִישׁ רוּחַ Prov 18:14 ; Mal 3:2 (object בּוֺאוֺ אֶתיֿוֺם ); of sustaining a cause, in court, ׳יְכַל בְּמִשְׁמָּט דְּבָרָיו Psa 112:5 . Polpal Perfect 3plural כָּלְכְּלוּ were supplied with food 1Kin 20:27 (Klo proposes בַּגִּלְבֹּעַ ). Hiph`il Imperfect יָכִיל 1Kin 7:26 2 t. etc.; Infinitive construct הָכִיל Jer 6:11 5 t.; — contain, hold, hold in, endure ; 1 contain , followed by accusative (of liquid) 1Kin 7:26 , 38 ; 2Chr 4:5 ; in figure Jer 2:13 , absolute Ezek 23:32 ; (of burnt-offering) 1Kin 8:64 ; 2Chr 7:7 ; hold in (wrath of ׳י , object not expressed, subject Jeremiah) Jer 6:11 (opposed to שָׁפַךְ ). 2 sustain, endure , followed by accusative Amos 7:10 ; Jer 10:10 ; Joel 2:11 . כִּלְכֵּל verb , כַּלְכֹּל proper name, masculine see below כול .
